assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D sprite animation atlas for UA Force side-scrolling pixel action game. EXACT uniform grid 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 isolated frames, equal cells. Each cell looks like a TRUE 48x48 pixel sprite enlarged nearest-neighbor: extremely chunky square pixel clusters, bold dark 1-pixel outline, flat 3 shades per material, NO gradients, soft lighting, texture noise, anti-aliasing, isometric perspective, realistic rendering or text. Transparent background, no checkerboard; if transparency impossible use perfectly flat pure magenta #ff00ff. Shared restricted palette: dark navy #152638, slate #42566c, cream #fff1c3, gold #efb34c, sky blue #59b9ec, olive #687344, teal #36b8a4. ROW1: same Ukrainian olive military open-top jeep facing RIGHT in FOUR moving suspension/wheel frames. ROW2: same ethereal teal Ukrainian mounted cavalry rider with saber, horse facing RIGHT, FOUR distinct galloping leg poses. ROW3: same olive Ukrainian transport helicopter facing RIGHT, FOUR distinct spinning rotor blade positions, blue-yellow tiny marking. ROW4: same olive friendly walking robotic gun turret facing RIGHT, FOUR distinct stepping leg poses. No glow around ghost cavalry, only flat teal pixels. Every frame same scale, SAME pivot within its row, centered with 4 logical pixels clear padding, no frames crossing cell boundaries, no gutters or drawn grid lines. Readability at 48x48 is the overriding priority.

Use case: stylized-concept. UA Force game ability effects sprite animation atlas: exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, sixteen equal 48x48 logical pixel cells enlarged nearest neighbor. Ultra chunky hand-placed square pixel art, bold navy contour, only flat blocks of colors (cream #fff1c3, gold #efb34c, blue #59b9ec, teal #36b8a4, dark navy #152638). All frames transparent, no painted checkerboard; perfectly flat magenta #ff00ff ONLY if transparency impossible. No blur, smooth glow, gradient, lighting, fine texture or smooth curves. At most 12 colors. Row 1: four animation frames of protective Ukrainian ornamental shield aura, circular wreath of golden wheat and blue angular energy segments, hollow transparent center, expanding outward, strong stepped pixel arcs. Row 2: four frames of blue wispy invisibility shroud, hollow humanoid silhouette made from separated angular ribbons at the perimeter, dissipating from left to right, NO person inside. Row 3: four teal electronic disruption bursts: angular broken rings with a small trident-shaped emblem and square sparks, pulsing outward. Row 4: four frames of a huge blue-gold sonic crescent moving RIGHT, from compact crescent to broad jagged impact burst and dissipating chunks. Maintain exact centers, common scale within each row, six logical pixels of margin; individual sprites never cross cell boundaries. This is raw game sprite artwork, NOT icons in boxes or a poster. Chunkiness and clear clusters matter more than detail.

Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a production UA Force pixel-art sprite animation atlas, EXACT 4 columns x 2 rows, 8 equal square cells. True coarse 48x48 logical pixels per cell enlarged with nearest-neighbor. Flat hard-edged large square clusters, 1-pixel dark navy contour, three-tone shading. NOT detailed high-resolution pixel illustration. No gradients, antialiasing, blur, soft aura or checkerboard. Transparent background; if not possible use solid flat pure magenta #ff00ff. Shared colors: navy #152638, slate #42566c, blue #59b9ec, cream #fff1c3, dark green #34442d, olive #687344, teal #36b8a4, pale mint #79dbc0, brown #936539. ROW 1: SAME raven facing RIGHT, four distinct flapping-wing animation poses, wings high / horizontal / down / folded. Black-navy body, slate wing masses and strong pale blue rim FEATHER PIXEL CLUSTERS so the bird reads clearly against dark bunker walls; not a smooth glow. Same scale, centered, six pixels margin in every cell. ROW 2: four sequential ground-root eruption frames, initially tiny pale-mint shoots, then medium angular brown roots and bright teal leaves, then large grasping curling thorny roots, finally full growth with fluttering leaves. Roots all anchored to exactly the same bottom baseline, six pixels above cell bottom. Distinct stages, no overlapping adjacent cells. No text, labels or borders. Side-scroller artwork, flat profile, simple confident shapes readable at 48x48.

Use case: stylized-concept. UA Force side-scroller 2D sprite atlas, EXACT 4 columns x 2 rows of equal square cells. Genuine coarse 48x48 logical pixel art per cell, enlarged nearest neighbor. HARD square clusters, thick dark navy edge, three flat tones per material, no gradients, glow, texture, blur, realistic lighting or antialiasing. Transparent background; flat magenta #ff00ff only if genuine alpha impossible. Row1: FOUR different rotor animation frames of the SAME tiny friendly Ukrainian attack quadcopter in STRICT SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT, silver-grey readable body, two visible separated rotor booms, small BLUE and YELLOW marking and one red sensor. This is a hovering drone, not a creature, mech or airplane. Wide low silhouette, all frames same position, same scale and baseline. Clear pale silver upper edges to stand out against a black bunker. Row2: cell0 poison crossbow BOLT projectile facing RIGHT, long wooden shaft with bright mint triangular arrowhead, no crossbow itself; cell1 teal hacking projectile, angular hollow sparking orb; cell2 gold short melee crescent swing facing RIGHT; cell3 crisp golden muzzle FLASH star. All objects contained with six logical pixels padding. No text, borders, drawn grid or checkerboard. Minimal purposeful clusters with strong silhouettes, readable at original 48-pixel size.
